brief:
Israel's chief opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot warned Thursday that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was working to undermine the legitimacy of election results, Middle East Eye reported. Eisenkot did not elaborate on specific allegations Netanyahu has made regarding the vote.

The warning reflects deepening tensions between Netanyahu and his political rivals as Israel navigates post-election proceedings. Eisenkot's comments add to ongoing disputes over the integrity of Israel's electoral process.

title: Eisenkot accuses Netanyahu of delegitimising election results
